_comment: Thresholds for the technical-analysis layer (PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md section 74: indicators need minimum observations and liquidity thresholds set in config; below them, INSUFFICIENT_DATA). Indicators describe price behaviour; they never change the valuation, the cost of equity or the model view.
_max_zero_volume_share_note: If more than this share of an indicator's window had no trade, the repeated closes would be read as calm or momentum that never happened, so the indicator is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
_stale_after_days_note: Calendar days between the last stored close and today after which every indicator is marked STALE.
